subject: trekkies
one_liner: A messaging service that applies the transmission delay your stated position requires, because instant delivery was never canon.
brand_voice_notes: Straight-faced ecclesiastical infrastructure. Subspace never jokes about fandom and never calls itself fun. It speaks the way a body that maintains a doctrine speaks: continuity is a duty, a message is a record, a contradiction is an incident. Canon is referred to as the established material. Users are crew. Delay is not a limitation, it is compliance. Nothing is winking. The company genuinely believes a group chat requires a chain of command.

hero.h1: Nothing arrives instantly. Nothing ever did.
hero.sub: Subspace holds every message for the transit time your stated coordinates require, issues every group chat a bridge roster, and reviews your outbound text against the established material before anyone reads it. Median delivery is nine minutes. Nobody has asked us to shorten it.

features.title: Transit is calculated, not simulated
features.blurb: You enter your position. We take it at face value. Every message is then held for the exact interval a signal would need to cross that distance, down to the second, and released without further comment. Most crews sit between four and eleven minutes apart. One pair sits at 4.24 years. They have filed nothing.

features.title: Every channel has a bridge
features.blurb: Group chats are issued a roster: Comms, Helm, Science, Engineering, Medical. Only the officer holding Comms may transmit. Everyone else files into the suggestion log, which Comms is under no obligation to open. Rotation runs weekly, is published fourteen days out, and cannot be edited by anyone including us.

features.title: Continuity is reviewed before delivery
features.blurb: An on-device reviewer checks each outbound message against 1,140 hours of established material. A contradiction is not deleted. It is held, logged, cited, and attached to your continuity score, which is visible to every member of the channel and does not reset.

demo_screen_concept: A single bridge channel open in the Subspace client. Left rail: a station roster of six crew, each with a station badge (Comms, Helm, Science, Engineering, Medical, Cadet), a continuity score in mono, and a lock glyph on everyone who is not currently holding Comms. Centre: the message thread, where delivered messages sit as leaded glass panes and messages you just sent sit in an IN TRANSIT state with a live per-message countdown ticking down in seconds before they drop into the thread. The composer is disabled with an explanatory notice unless you hold Comms, and is replaced by a 'file into the suggestion log' input that visibly appends to a collapsible log nobody reads. Right rail: the continuity panel, showing your score, the channel average, and any held message with its citation, an established-material reference code and a Hold / Appeal pair of buttons. A TAKE COMMS button sits above the roster and, when pressed, declines with the next scheduled rotation date.

images.rationale: Hero skipped because the direction is a glazed window and the hero centrepiece is a CSS rose window built from conic and radial gradients, which a photograph would only fight. Demo subject assets skipped because the demo_screen_concept is a chat thread and a station roster, which is text and badge shaped rather than photo shaped, and the roster badges are quarry panes in CSS. Whole budget went to the three testimonial headshots, duotoned into cobalt and framed by a quarry with a gold nimbus on the landing page.

design_direction.style: Leaded stained-glass window, cathedral dark mode. The page is staged as a set of lancet windows glazed for a messaging company that has decided a fan's memory of the established material is scripture and a group chat is a chapter house. One lead-black ground (#0D0F16) runs the entire page with no light mode, no glass-morphism, no backdrop blur, no clay volume, no bento lattice, no newsprint, no moulded plastic, no plaster, no banknote plate, no enamel plate, no sprocket rail, no drafting grid and no wall labels. Nothing on the page casts a shadow, because a window is lit from behind and has no front. In place of shadow the page has transmission: every coloured pane carries a faint inner glow (an inset box-shadow of its own hue at 8 to 14 percent, never higher) and a mottled texture built in pure CSS from three offset radial-gradients at 4 to 7 percent opacity, so no area of colour is ever flat and every pane reads as glass with light coming through it rather than paint sitting on a card. Nothing has a border radius above 2px except the lancet head, which is a pointed arch cut with clip-path, never a border-radius. The organising move is the light: every major section is a window light, a full-width block hemmed left and right by a 3px lead came in near-black (#05060A) and opened by a pointed-arch tracery head, so sections arrive as glazing rather than as cards in a grid. The core motif is the quarry: a 14px diamond pane rotated 45 degrees inside a 2px lead came, filled with cobalt or bone, used as the list bullet, the feature index, the pricing tier mark, the roster badge and the section seam marker, so every discrete item on the page reads as one small pane set into a window. The second motif is the came seam: a 3px near-black rule with a 1px bone highlight along its upper edge only, the way lead catches light on one side, hemming every section and every pane boundary. The third motif is the nimbus: a 1px gold ring (#C9A227) set 6px outside a portrait or a numeral, used only where the company is asserting that a person or a figure is authoritative. One cathedral cobalt (#2F5FC7) is the sole structural colour: the wordmark, every headline accent, every quarry, every primary CTA and every delivered pane, always as a flat flood or hairline with lead black knocked out of it. One rationed ruby (#C2413E) is quarantined strictly to continuity-failure telemetry (held messages, contradictions, scores below 70, expired watches, overridden delays, the withheld line in pricing) and appears nowhere decorative, so the only warm colour on a cold page is always the service informing you that you have misremembered. Cinzel sets the wordmark and headlines in inscriptional Roman caps at monumental sizes with the flat authority of something cut into a lintel, tracking opened to 0.04em at display sizes and set flush left against the came. Spectral carries plain, faintly liturgical body copy at 17px with a 1.62 line-height and a 66-character measure. Every figure that pretends to be relay telemetry (transit seconds, continuity scores, watch numbers, relay hops, reference codes, tier prices) is set in Space Mono with tabular figures inside recessed wells one step darker than the ground with a 1px cobalt hairline along the top edge only, so it reads like the log, not marketing. Portraits are duotoned into cobalt and lead black with a CSS filter and framed by a quarry with a gold nimbus, so a person always arrives as a figure in a window. Motion is glazing-restrained: cames draw in from the top once on reveal over 600ms, panes raise their inner glow from 0 to full on hover with no lift and no scale, CTAs invert to a cobalt flood with lead-black type knocked out and depress 1px on press, ruby counters step once on entering the viewport and then hold, sections fade up 6px on a 40ms stagger, all gated behind prefers-reduced-motion. No light mode, no blur, no neon, no gradients on type, no scanlines, no CRT curvature, no clay shadow pairs, no offset sticker shadows, no bento lattice, no halftone dot screens, no misregistration, no rubrication, no versals, no guilloche, no lathe rules, no leg bands, no chenille patches, no cartridges, no title blocks, no dimension lines, no split-flap numerals, no HUD corner brackets, no emoji. Reads like an institution that files your group chat under 'chapter house' and considers your recollection of an episode a matter of record.
design_direction.archetype: Consumer messaging product page issued as a set of glazed lancet windows: a rose-window hero carrying a monumental inscriptional claim over a relay telemetry strip in mono, three numbered feature lights indexed by quarries, three testimonial lights with quarry-framed duotone portraits under gold nimbi and chapter registration numbers, a three-tier commission schedule laid out as a ruled roster rather than floating cards, a closing observance band, and a handoff to the bridge channel demo.
design_direction.motion_vocab: One orchestrated moment and nothing else: the twelve panes of the hero rose window glaze in on a 40ms stagger at load, once. After that the page moves only in answer to a pointer. Panes raise their inner glow on hover, never lift and never scale. CTAs invert to a cobalt flood and depress 1px on press. No scroll-triggered section reveals, so no copy is ever hidden waiting on a script. All gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Full-bleed lancet light on lead black. A CSS rose window sits centre-right, built from repeating-conic-gradient tracery and twelve quarry panes in cobalt with a single ruby pane at the eleven o'clock position. The h1 sits flush left against a 3px came in Cinzel caps at clamp(2.6rem, 7vw, 5.2rem), tracking 0.04em, with the sub set in Spectral at a 62ch measure beneath it. A relay telemetry strip in Space Mono runs under the CTA pair: median transit, relays online, channels under review, and one ruby figure for messages currently held.
